title: List of Melbourne High School alumni
extracted_sentences: This is a List of Melbourne High School alumni, they being notable former students - known as "Old Boys" of the public selective school, the Melbourne High School in South Yarra, Victoria, Australia.

In 2001, The Sun-Herald ranked Melbourne High School third in Australia's top ten boys' schools, based on the number of its alumni mentioned in the Who's Who in Australia (a listing of notable Australians) .
